text: Here, amid gleaming glass and bright, modern surfaces, I feel a curious stillness. There is potential in the vacant room—a lull before ideas awaken and fill the air with conversation. But stepping next to the colorful, vibrant wall of 'R+D,' curiosity stirs stronger. The words and displays around me whisper of innovation and promise, urging me to contemplate progress and the collaboration that shapes our future. I feel present, and almost ready to begin anew.
